definitions.explanation: The geological process by which rock is broken down in place by exposure to weather — temperature changes, water, and chemical reactions — without being carried away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{風化作用|ふうかさよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{崩|くず}れる→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧。
{風化作用|ふうかさよう}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{岩石|がんせき}→岩石：20502_ganseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{風化作用|ふうかさよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{割|わ}れ{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Weathering from temperature changes creates cracks in the rock.

notes:
USAGE: {風化作用|ふうかさよう} is weathering — the in-place breakdown of rock — combining ⟦{風化|ふうか}→風化：17583_fuuka⟧ (weathering) with ⟦{作用|さよう}→作用：05761_sayou⟧ (action). Note that ⟦{風化|ふうか}→風化：17583_fuuka⟧ on its own also means figuratively "to fade from memory."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風化作用|ふうかさよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be subject to weathering
- ⟦{物理的|ぶつりてき}→物理的：06197_butsuriteki⟧{風化作用|ふうかさよう}: physical weathering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{侵食作用|しんしょくさよう}→侵食作用：29626_shinshokusayou⟧: erosion — wears rock away and transports it
- ⟦{風化|ふうか}→風化：17583_fuuka⟧: weathering; fading — the base noun, also used figuratively
